name: Letter
summary: Private-banking gallery style with a dark vault hero, white editorial body, serif display headlines, extended grotesque UI text, 2px controls, tinted feature cards, and floating metallic 3D renders.

typography.display_fallback: GT Sectra, Tiempos Headline, Canela, Playfair Display, Georgia, serif
typography.body_fallback: Sohne, Inter, IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

layout.composition: full-bleed dark hero followed by centered white, mist, and tinted gallery sections

do: Use serif display type for all headlines.
Use 80px type for hero headlines only.
Pair filled buttons with same-color ghost text links.
Use 3D renders as the main depth mechanism.
dont: Do not set headlines in a sans-serif.
Do not add rounded cards, pill buttons, or circular avatars.
Do not use brand action colors for body text or large backgrounds.
Do not use tinted cards as full-page backgrounds.
Do not apply gradients to UI components.
Do not mask or frame 3D renders.
